input: Pinned Stage R 25 declared Cicada number/byte sources, each mapped mod 29 and by rejection to make 50 cyclic key streams; LP2 source sections 7–15 separately and joined 7–15, using pinned source corpus and solved-LP1 unigram distribution.
search: All 50 key streams ×10 section alignments ×3 modes sub/add/beaufort ×29 shifts = 43,500 distinct source settings. Each score averages the drift-tolerant likelihood over every cyclic key phase; none is a selected best phase. GP29 positions, epsilon0.1, rho0.02, pruning1e-12 and threshold +30 nats as source.
controls: Source deterministic seed3301: each 50-key model, lengths729 and3316, fresh/next anti-doublet rekey, keep0.19; its own-key and wrong-key scores (200 pairs). Any own-key <+30 or wrong-key >=+30 voids the screen.
replay: Compute exact source settings and controls using a separately written Numba sparse-forward kernel. Require numerical parity with pinned source fastdetect on fixed real LP2 cells across short/medium/long keys, all modes and boundary alignments before full run; verify all 43,500 candidate and 200 control rows against the pinned original TSVs at source 0.01-nat serialization precision. This is an accelerated reimplementation, not execution of the unmodified source main program.
limitations: The detector uses solved-LP1 unigram frequencies and a fixed drift model. Fixed source bytes, two mappings and these ten alignments only; no other keys, language models, transformations, key schedules or plaintext interpretation. A low score does not disprove a key if the source detector has inadequate power for that input/length; control gate is limited to its planted sources and lengths.
